mprViewColorOn3D.Description: Displaying view visibility ranges in color on 3D using DirectShape
mprViewColorOn3D.FullDescription: Creating view visibility ranges as DirectShape elements in color on 3D views, based on view crop regions with the depth of the primary range of plans or crop depth of sections, elevations, and callouts. View navigation is available from the plugin window
